mapper.update: INSERT INTO access_stat_daily (stat_date, site_id, total_visits, unique_visitors, unique_sessions, page_views, avg_response_ms, error_count) SELECT #{targetDate}::date, #{siteId}, COUNT(*) AS total_visits, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_hash) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS unique_sessions, COUNT(*) AS page_views, COALESCE(AVG(response_time_ms)::int,0) AS avg_response_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 500) AS error_count FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' AND site_id = #{siteId} ON CONFLICT (stat_date, site_id) DO UPDATE SET total_visits = EXCLUDED.total_visits, unique_visitors = EXCLUDED.unique_visitors, unique_sessions = EXCLUDED.unique_sessions, page_views = EXCLUDED.page_views, avg_response_ms = EXCLUDED.avg_response_ms, error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count
mapper.select: SELECT stat_date, site_id, total_visits, unique_visitors, unique_sessions, page_views, avg_response_ms, error_count FROM access_stat_daily WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND site_id = #{siteId}
SELECT stat_date, total_visits, page_views, error_count FROM access_stat_daily WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT stat_date, total_visits, page_views, error_count FROM access_stat_daily WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND stat_date >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS stat_date, #{siteId} AS site_id, COUNT(*) AS total_visits, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_hash) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS unique_sessions, COUNT(*) AS page_views, COALESCE(AVG(response_time_ms)::int, 0) AS avg_response_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 500) AS error_count FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS stat_date, #{siteId} AS site_id, COUNT(*) AS total_visits, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_hash) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS unique_sessions, COUNT(*) AS page_views, COALESCE(AVG(response_time_ms)::int, 0) AS avg_response_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 500) AS error_count FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT al.page_url, MAX(m.name) AS menu_name, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT al.ip_hash) AS unique_visitors, COALESCE(AVG(al.response_time_ms)::bigint, 0) AS avg_response_ms, ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE al.status_code >= 500)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4 ) AS error_rate FROM access_log al LEFT JOIN menu m ON m.url = al.page_url AND m.site_id = #{siteId} WHERE al.site_id = #{siteId} AND al.created_at >= #{from}::date AND al.created_at < #{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY al.page_url ORDER BY visit_count DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT page_url) FROM access_log WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < #{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day'
